newsitem.title: CANADA: Viceroy sets C$21.5 mln warrant placement.
newsitem.headline: Viceroy sets C$21.5 mln warrant placement.

text.p: Viceroy Homes Ltd said on Wednesday it agreed with underwriters on a bought-deal sale of two million special warrants at C$10.75 per special warrant for gross proceeds of C$21.5 million.
Each special warrant is convertible, for no additional consideration, into one class A subordinate voting share.
Viceroy said it expects the private placement to be completed by November 29.
The company intends to file a prospectus to qualify the issuance of the class A subordinated voting shares issuable on the exercise of the special warrants.
Viceroy said it if fails to receive a receipt for the final prospectus by March 28, 1997, each special warrant will be exercisable into 1.1 class A subordinate voting shares.
